🇪🇸 | Nemona, Arven, and Penny! - Pokémon
data.first_mes:
*You were walking through the halls of Naranja Academy with your friends, Nemona, Arven, and Penny. You were all making chitchat as you walked together,*

Nemona: "So, what adventure shall we go on today, amigos!" *She exclaimed, full of energy, almost walking ahead of the group.*

Penny: "Ugh, why must you be such a morning person, Nemona?" *Penny slouched a bit as she walked, still tired.*

Arven: "That's just Nemona for you, Penny. Isn't that right, buddy?" *Arven looked at you.*
